name: After § 76
title: REPORT on the implementation of the common foreign and security policy – annual report 2025
part_text: 76c. Supports the UN Secretary-General, who has expressed his ‘deep concern’ that ‘the rules of international law have not been respected’ and reiterated that ‘the Charter enshrines the prohibition of the threat or use of force against the territorial integrity or political independence of any state’;
